title: KP14 with the y exposure on the PROFITABILITY DEVIATION: three types b_f = [0.1, 0.25, 0.45], cash flow x K^a u [1 + (eps - 1) e^(b_f y)], price 2.5
question: Does a type x profitability product, b_f (eps - 1), give KP14 an interaction gap of 0.1/yr without the sign-switching ladder's hump?
notes:
WHY (2026-10-30 23:50). The KP14 interaction slot: every lever on the positive ladder (loadings x2 / x3, price 3.5, bv_comp 2.5) left room at vyg25's 19-28%, and the sign-switching ladders' premium is hump-shaped whatever the compensation, because the type enters only through b and the level. This gives KP14 a genuine second dimension: the exposure multiplies the firm's profitability deviation, so profitable firms (eps > 1) load positively on y and unprofitable ones negatively, with the type setting the scale. The exposure b_f (eps - 1) is mean zero across firms and a product of a partly hidden type and a visible within-firm state (ROE), the structure the reduced form's latent product and GS21's imposed product share.

IMPLEMENTATION (parameters_kp14 bv_on_eps, commit of 2026-10-30): a0, a2 solved with b = 0 and a1, a3 with b_f, e^{b y} folded into a1, a3; the growth-option solve and the simulator use no wholesale e^{b y} (b_eff_whole = 0); the unit project value is clipped at 0 at the investment margin (no investment when NPV <= 0: with the eps-part exposed it turns negative for eps < 0.3 beyond the table grid). type_theta = 1 (a0 is type-free). Mode off is op-for-op identical (parity test on vyg25s's tables). Loadings chosen so the unit value stays positive on the table grid for eps >= 0.1 (b <= 0.45; the effective exposure sd is about 0.24 b, so 0.024-0.11, vyg25's range).

PREDICTION (2026-10-30): the premium monotone in eps within type and the type visible through book-to-market only (no level difference); room above vyg25's 24%; fair gap +0.03 to +0.10. FALSIFIED if room is at or below 28% on three seeds.
